caption: The drawing depicts a detailed ceramic pitcher with a metallic lid. The pitcher is rendered in beige and light brown tones, with shadows and highlights adding dimension. Its exterior surface is textured and decorated with sculpted floral and leaf motifs in relief, including prominent flowers and stems wrapping around the body. The handle is curved, thick, and also features raised organic detailing. The metallic lid is shown in a darker shade, suggesting a pewter or silver material, and has a small thumb lever for opening. There are two smaller inset illustrations in the top left and bottom right corners; both display different views of the same pitcher, one from a side view and one from behind, emphasizing the lid's shape and handle details. The pitcher is centered within a rectangular border, and the name "JOHN DANA" is written at the bottom center within the border. The background is a plain, slightly yellowed off-white.
title: Syrup Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
